style.backgroundSystem: soft sky-blue panels #C5E6F2/#E4F4FB for hero and archive screens, warm apricot #F5DCAD for growing-story and CTA screens, grey-blue stone #A2ACBB for detail insets, white-washed wood #EDE7DD for flat lays
style.direction: fresh fruit e-commerce, appetizing and clean
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single leaf-green #7FA75A accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused light with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows; natural bloom on fruit skin, glistening juicy flesh, never plastic-looking
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-fruit e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft sky-blue #C5E6F2, warm apricot #F5DCAD, deep teal-blue text #256E8C and one fresh leaf-green accent #7FA75A for badges and icons; bright soft diffused lighting with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows, natural bloom on the fruit skin and glistening juicy flesh, never plastic-looking; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal-blue only; consistent rounded rectangle and pill-shaped info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean appetizing fruit photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for whole fruit with stem, halved fruit always shows the cut face toward camera; consistent fruit scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte grey-blue stone slab #A2ACBB, white-washed wood planks #EDE7DD, light bamboo wicker
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal-blue #256E8C only, labels 10-14pt, with one fresh leaf-green accent #7FA75A reserved for small badges, thin-line icons and dividers
